const short gs[] = {0,62,74,118,186,208,253,321,342,427,496};
const short ge[] = {62,74,118,186,208,253,321,342,427,496,507};
float tSec = floor(fmax(kTime + kFloat0, 0.0f));
int ti = (int)tSec;
int hh = (ti / 3600) % 100;
int mm = (ti / 60) % 60;
int ss = ti % 60;
int tc[8] = {hh / 10, hh % 10, 10, mm / 10, mm % 10, 10, ss / 10, ss % 10};
float sz = kFloat2 > 0.0f ? kFloat2 : 1.0f;
float em = 0.181472f * (float)p_Height * sz;
float totW = 0.0f;
for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { totW += (tc[i] == 10 ? 0.33301f : 0.55615f) + 0.005f; }
float ox = 0.5f * (float)p_Width - 0.5f * totW * em + kFloat3;
float oy = 0.05433f * (float)p_Height + kFloat4;
float sIn = 0.00646f * em;
float sOut = (clamp(kFloat5, 0.0f, 10.0f) - 1.69f) * em / 261.32f;
float blr = 0.05977f * em;
float shX = 0.01982f * em;
float shY = 0.01676f * em;
float dTxt = 1.0e6f;
float dSh = 1.0e6f;
for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
  if (pass == 1 && kFloat1 >= 0.5f) { break; }
  float qx = (float)x + 0.5f - (pass == 1 ? shX : 0.0f);
  float qy = (float)y + 0.5f + (pass == 1 ? shY : 0.0f);
  float cx0 = ox;
  float dBest = 1.0e6f;
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    int g = tc[i];
    float adv = (g == 10 ? 0.33301f : 0.55615f) + 0.005f;
    float u = (qx - cx0) / em;
    float v = (qy - oy) / em;
    if (u > -0.12f && u < adv + 0.12f && v > -0.25f && v < 0.95f) {
      float bd = 1.0e6f;
      int cr = 0;
      for (int k = gs[g]; k < ge[g] - 1; k++) {
        float ax = (float)gp[2 * k];
        float bx = (float)gp[2 * k + 2];
        if (ax < -5000.0f || bx < -5000.0f) { continue; }
        ax *= 0.0001f; bx *= 0.0001f;
        float ay = (float)gp[2 * k + 1] * 0.0001f;
        float by = (float)gp[2 * k + 3] * 0.0001f;
        float ex = bx - ax;
        float ey = by - ay;
        float tt = clamp(((u - ax) * ex + (v - ay) * ey) / (ex * ex + ey * ey), 0.0f, 1.0f);
        float ddx = u - ax - tt * ex;
        float ddy = v - ay - tt * ey;
        bd = fmin(bd, ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy);
        if ((ay > v) != (by > v)) {
          if (u < ax + (v - ay) * ex / (by - ay)) { cr ^= 1; }
        }
      }
      float sd = sqrt(bd) * em;
      dBest = fmin(dBest, cr ? -sd : sd);
    }
    cx0 += adv * em;
  }
  if (pass == 0) { dTxt = dBest; } else { dSh = dBest; }
}
float aSh = kFloat1 >= 0.5f ? 0.0f : 0.731f * (1.0f - smoothstep(sOut - blr, sOut + blr, dSh));
float aBk = 1.0f - smoothstep(sOut - 0.75f, sOut + 0.75f, dTxt);
float aWh = 1.0f - smoothstep(-sIn - 0.75f, -sIn + 0.75f, dTxt);
float rr = kOutput.x;
float gg = kOutput.y;
float bb = kOutput.z;
float aa = kOutput.w;
float na = aSh + aa * (1.0f - aSh);
float k0 = na > 0.0f ? aa * (1.0f - aSh) / na : 0.0f;
rr *= k0; gg *= k0; bb *= k0; aa = na;
na = aBk + aa * (1.0f - aBk);
k0 = na > 0.0f ? aa * (1.0f - aBk) / na : 0.0f;
rr *= k0; gg *= k0; bb *= k0; aa = na;
na = aWh + aa * (1.0f - aWh);
k0 = na > 0.0f ? aa * (1.0f - aWh) / na : 0.0f;
rr = rr * k0 + 0.973f * aWh / fmax(na, 1.0e-6f);
gg = gg * k0 + 0.973f * aWh / fmax(na, 1.0e-6f);
bb = bb * k0 + 0.973f * aWh / fmax(na, 1.0e-6f);
aa = na;
kOutput = (float4)(rr, gg, bb, aa);
